06 · DESIGN WORKS

Design, in Motion.

An ad, a movie poster, a sake brand and a piece of type: each shown as the finished layout with its video playing on a loop right beside it: an animation for the ad, and the Photoshop build timelapse for the sake brand and the type.

01 Ad Design 02 Movie Poster 03 Sake Brand 04 Typography
No. 01Ad Design

The Journey of Crunch

An infographic-style ad that follows a potato chip through its whole journey (selected, sliced, cooked, seasoned and packed) inside one cutaway cup. The finished layout sits beside its animated version.

No. 02Movie Poster Design

500 Days of Summer

A typographic poster built on a grid of film stills in a cyan-and-red duotone, with loose type and a worn paper texture to match the film's bittersweet mood.

tap the poster to enlarge ↗
No. 03Sake Brand

日本の魂, the Soul of Japan

A sake brand poster led by a bold Japanese title, a red seal and a Niigata origin story, with the bottle set against open sky and grass. Its Photoshop build timelapse plays alongside.

No. 04Typography

Hope Never Dies

Type made physical: heavy white letterforms wrapped in vines and a garden of sunflowers and gerberas on a warm orange ground, with the Photoshop build timelapse beside it.
